payload.headline: Micron drops 2.52% to 778.31 on no news; holds above key support

summary.thesis: Micron is an A-grade business earning peak margins, and at 778.31 the price already assumes most of today's cash flow holds, so there is little margin of safety either way.
summary.decision: Hold for the long term and add only near the 730.39–745.13 support zone; no swing trade until support is tested or resistance is cleared.
summary.act_at: add at 745.13; trim above 833.11; reassess below 643.63

payload.happening: MU fell 2.52% to 778.31 from 798.44. There was no news, and the price slipped back below the 803.77–818.52 resistance zone. The next earnings report is on 2026-12-23, and options price an 8.9% move by 2026-11-20.
payload.business: Nothing changed in the business today. The drop affects sentiment, not the business. The latest filed numbers are very strong: trailing revenue was 133.2B, up from 37.4B (249.6% growth). The operating margin was 74.59%, up from 26.14%. Free cash flow was 59.0B, up from 1.7B. Net cash is 40.6B, with only 2.8B of debt. The balance sheet and cash are not at risk. What is at risk is the margin. The filings flag that a 75% operating margin sits at the top of a 5-year range that runs from -41% to 75%, and memory makers' profits swing with the industry cycle (general knowledge). Insiders sold $14.0M outside pre-set plans. That is a governance and sentiment note, not a business change. Revenue segments are not available in our data.

worth.text: A full cash-flow model isn't used here, because free cash flow jumped from 1.7B to 59.0B in one year and a jump like that can't be projected forward. Two simpler checks disagree. Against its own history, the price-to-sales ratio (price divided by yearly sales per share) of 6.6 sits at the 78th percentile of its own 5 years. That history gives a range of 322.32–833.11, with a midpoint of 490.66, so the stock looks expensive by that measure. Against peers it looks cheap: 6.6 versus a peer median of 8.6, and only 10.5 times trailing earnings. The sensitivity table settles it. The price implies starting cash-flow growth of only 2.1%. Zero growth is worth 715.13, and 10% growth is worth 1058.07. If the operating margin falls to 37%, value is 793.55, close to today's price. So the price assumes the business keeps most of its current cash flow but not all of it. The gap between the two methods comes from whether today's peak margin lasts.
worth.key_assumption: Free cash flow stays near today's 59.0B and does not shrink sharply as the 74.59% operating margin fades from its 5-year peak.

bull: Trailing revenue grew 249.6%, and the latest quarter grew 345.03% year over year and 30.81% from the prior quarter.
Net cash of 40.6B and a trailing P/E of 10.5 give the stock a cushion, and its price-to-sales of 6.6 is below the peer median of 8.6.
Even if the operating margin falls to 37%, the valuation table gives 793.55, above today's 778.31.
bear: The operating margin jumped to 74.59% from 26.14%, and the filings say peaks like this usually fade.
The price is far above the own-history midpoint of 490.66, at the 78th percentile of its own 5-year price-to-sales range.
The 50-day average of 943.69 and the 20-day average of 838.0 are both falling, and insiders sold $14.0M outside pre-set plans.

levels.what: Top of the 730.39–745.13 support zone, close to the 715.13 value that assumes zero cash-flow growth. A better place to add.
Top of the own-history valuation range. Above it the price needs today's peak to last, so it is a level to trim.
Bottom of the lower support zone (643.63–658.37, two touches). A close below it would suggest the market doubts the margins.

longterm.why: The business is A-grade with 40.6B of net cash, but at 778.31 the price sits inside the 715.13–833.11 fair range with little margin of safety. Holding fits that; adding is better near 745.13.

swing.why: The price is in a sideways range, between the 200-day average at 765.42 and resistance at 803.77–818.52, and the 20-day average of 838.0 is falling. With a 58.97 ATR (average daily trading range), the reward to the next resistance is small for the risk. Enter only if the 730.39–745.13 support holds on a test, or on a close above 861.0.

decision.timing: Options price a 21.8% move by 2027-01-15, which includes the 2026-12-23 report. Implied volatility of 70.7 is below the recent realized 104.2, so swings may run larger than options price, and large new positions before the report carry event risk.

change_mind: A close below 643.63, the bottom of the lower support zone, would move the long-term call from hold toward avoid.
If the 2026-12-23 report shows the operating margin near 37% or lower, value falls to around 793.55 or less, removing any cushion at today's price. That would argue to trim.
A close above 861.0, the top of the upper resistance zone, would turn the swing call to enter, with the 803.77–818.52 zone as a base.
payload.what_changed: Unchanged: still hold, because the 2.52% drop to 778.31 came with no news and left the price above the 730.39–745.13 support zone.
payload.label: Research, not advice.
